description.value: White Spot is BC's longest-running restaurant chain, founded in 1928, and known for burgers made with 100% fresh Canadian beef and locally sourced BC ingredients. The Burnaby Kensington location on Hastings Street is a full-service sit-down restaurant offering breakfast, lunch, and dinner, with group dining and catering available. A touring cyclist riding the Hastings corridor would find a predictable, family-friendly stop with a broad menu and multiple takeout and delivery options.
